comparison.objective: Measure a pin diameter accurately with a digital caliper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a pin square but compliant while gently closing and releasing a caliper slider.
comparison.success_condition: Pin remains correctly located; display is within 0.05 mm of 23.40 mm; angular error at most 1 degree; jaw force at most 0.3 N.
comparison.reason: This is compliant metrology with a displayed static dimension, not adjustment and locking of a damper followed by dynamic validation.
